notes: litert-community/LFM3-Omni-2B-LiteRT: LFM3-Omni-2B_int8.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM generic_model conversion of LiquidAI/LFM3-Omni-2B at revision ce2458cb (LFM Open License v1.0): text, a picture (stretched to 512 x 512 by the runtime) and audio (16 kHz mono PCM) in, text out; the repo also ships the speech-out graphs and a Python runner. Mac rows: the shipped bytes themselves (run r1c 2026-10-28 17:5x-18:10 JST; the fixture suite again in run r4 22:55-23:02 from the upload stage). The speech-out path (the LM graph, depth_step, frame embed and codec in the Python runner) ran on this Mac in run r4 with ai-edge-litert 2.3.0: 12 / 12 runs equal run r1c's tokens, codes and PCM samples; its timing was not held in a quiet window, so it has no row. LANDED: LFM3-Omni-2B_int8.litertlm is in the Hub tree of litert-community/LFM3-Omni-2B-LiteRT from upload commit 6450f0619f63d9c5f8eb3e628a2ab477b53d78b9 (2026-10-28T15:04:52Z); the anonymous tree read at 2026-11-01T12:09:49+09:00 (main a287b6e6) gives LFS oid 959617973a7ddcb3d887fa0d9891d79556a266490d5c432b02a18ffcac3124ed and 3,226,750,192 B = artifact_sha256.
quantization: fp32-equivalent per-channel rewrite (alpha 0.65 on w2, out_proj and both norms; scales from 16 held-out calibration sequences) then dynamic-range int8 weights (dynamic_wi8_afp32) in the decoder and the embedder; vision encoder fp32 + adapter fp16, audio encoder fp32; generic_model, pictures 512 x 512 (256 rows), KV cache 4096, no activation type declared (the GPU runs float16 activations by default)
